plan.guidance: Get **three RBs by the Jaylen Warren / Tony Pollard range** — roughly the end of round 5. The position thins hard right after that.
Take **exactly two through rounds 5–6**. Don't front-load. The best WR values on this board all sit after pick 50.
Two clean paths: **Daniels or Hurts in round 5**, or **wait and pair two QBs after pick 100**. Nothing in between is worth it.
Bowers or McBride early, or **skip to Mark Andrews** — he's the single biggest value on the board. Stream if both plans die.
